data.name: Keemat
data.gender_notes: Keemat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A reward or requital for a good deed, a blessing from Allah. The name Keemat carries the meaning “Reward, Requital” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Keemat usually hope their child will grow to embody reward, requital and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the rewards of a good deed, and the importance of being grateful
data.etymology: Keemat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reward, Requital.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Keemat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: كيمات
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني قيمة أو مقدار أو وزن الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كيمات مشتق من الجذر العربي ك-ي-م، ويعني قيمة أو مقدار أو وزن الشيء. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر القيمة والقياس في عدة آيات، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحية ودلالة على أهمية القياس والتوازن في الحياة. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتصف بالحكمة والعدل في تقدير الأمور.

in_urdu.name: کیمات
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے قدر یا مقدار یا چیز کا وزن
in_urdu.long_meaning: کیمات نام عربی جڑ ک-ی-م سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قدر یا مقدار یا چیز کا وزن۔ قرآن کریم میں قدر اور قیاس کا ذکر کئی آیات میں آیا ہے، جو اس نام کو روحانی اہمیت اور زندگی میں قیاس اور توازن کی اہمیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو امور کے اندازے میں حکمت اور انصاف کے ساتھ ممتاز ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कीमत
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है मूल्य या मात्रा या वस्तु का वजन
in_hindi.long_meaning: कीमत नाम अरबी मूल क-य-म से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मूल्य या मात्रा या वस्तु का वजन। कुरआन में मूल्य और माप का उल्लेख कई आयतों में आया है, जो इस नाम को आध्यात्मिक महत्व और जीवन में माप और संतुलन के महत्व की ओर इशारा करता है। यह नाम अरबी इस्लामी संस्कृति में उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो मामलों के आकलन में बुद्धिमत्ता और न्याय के साथ विशिष्ट है।

in_pashto.name: کیمات
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم مطلب دی قیمت یا اندازه یا شی وزن
in_pashto.long_meaning: کیمات نوم د عربی جڑ ک-ی-م څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې دی قیمت یا اندازه یا شی وزن. په قرآن کریم کې د قیمت او قیاس ذکر په ډیرو آیاتو کې راغلی دی، چې دا نوم ته روحاني اهمیت او د ژوند په اندازه او توازن کې د اهمیت نښه کوي. دا نوم د عربی اسلامی کلتور کې د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې په امورو کې د حکمت او انصاف سره ځانګړی دی.

in_english.name: Keemat
in_english.meaning: The name means value, amount, or weight of a thing
in_english.long_meaning: The name Keemat is derived from the Arabic root k-y-m, which means value, amount, or weight of a thing. The Quran mentions value and measurement in several verses, giving the name a spiritual significance and highlighting the importance of measure and balance in life. In Islamic culture, the name is used to refer to a person characterized by wisdom and justice in their assessment of matters.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Keemat" has its roots deeply ingrained in the Arabic culture, where it is derived from the word "keemah" which means "reward" or "recompense". In the Islamic community, this name is reminiscent of the concept of the hereafter, where every action in this world will have a corresponding reaction or "keemat" in the next life. This belief in the principle of cause and effect is a central tenet of Islamic teachings and serves as a constant reminder for Muslims to lead virtuous lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Keemat holds great spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the Quranic verse, "Whatsoever of blessing and good things We give to mankind, comes from Us (Allah) alone, then to Us (Allah) will be their return." (16:54). The name is an affirmation of the belief that all blessings come from Allah and that they are a testament to Allah's mercy and generosity towards humanity. Additionally, the name is a call to remember the transient nature of worldly rewards and to focus instead on seeking spiritual rewards in the form of pleasing Allah and achieving eternal happiness in Jannah (Heaven).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Reward, Requital" symbolizes A reward or requital for a good deed, a blessing from Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Keemat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of reward, requital.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Keemat was a famous Sufi saint of the Chishti order, born in 1142 in present-day Afghanistan. The name Keemat carried significant weight in that era.
